answers.core: It is such a small addition that would fit seamlessly with the current core that it would seem foolish to add the overhead of adapting it as an add-on instead.
answers.workaround: As previously mentioned, I've had to replicate this functionality using a combination of several other nodes in other projects, so there is a work around but much more clunky and cumbersome to setup than it needs to be.

title: Add a toggle select mode to ItemList
